title: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
abstract: arXiv:2611.22179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. translated_title: 穿着风衣的RAG：极简记忆何时足以支撑智能体系统，何时又不够
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆研究在检索增强生成（RAG）之上累积了抽取、取代更新、反思与图谱合成等原语。然而，我们发现这些原语在我们测试的记忆基准中几乎都无法证明其成本是值得的：我们用BRIDGE展示了这一点——BRIDGE是一个刻意极简的RAG记忆系统，采用链式观察笔记、BM25与余弦相似度混合检索以及按时间顺序渲染，在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上与此前SOTA在bootstrap置信区间内持平，并在读取器相同的条件下以5.7-6.3分的优势超越最佳记忆基线（EverMemBench）。它每次查询仅消耗约5-7K读取器提示token，且每次写入或查询只需一次LLM调用。我们主张这种持平本身就是结果：标准基准衡量的是记忆检索到了什么，而非当智能体行动时记忆能实现什么。为了检验后者，我们引入了五个对抗性探测任务（规则应用±、模式归纳风格/程序性、动态多任务……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出刻意极简的RAG记忆系统BRIDGE，仅凭链式观察笔记、混合检索与时间排序渲染，就以极低成本（每次查询约5-7K token、单次LLM调用）在标准记忆基准上追平乃至超越复杂SOTA方法，进而论证标准基准只衡量记忆“检索到了什么”而非“能为智能体行动赋能什么”，并为此引入五个对抗性探测任务。
en_tdlr: A deliberately minimal RAG memory (BRIDGE)—chained observation notes, hybrid BM25+cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering—matches or beats sophisticated SOTA memory systems on standard benchmarks at a fraction of the cost, showing that benchmarks score what memory retrieves rather than what it enables, which the authors probe with five new adversarial tests.
